description: This is a shell script for launching diff and merge tools compatible with Git's external diff/merge interface. It manages prompts, external commands, and the execution flow for merging and diffing files during version control operations.

methods.name: should_prompt
methods.description: Determines if the user should be prompted before launching the diff/merge tool, based on Git configuration.

methods.name: use_ext_cmd
methods.description: Checks if an external command is specified for diff/merge operations.

methods.name: launch_merge_tool
methods.description: Launches the specified merge or diff tool, optionally prompting the user and handling external commands.
